messages:
anya-cs: Quick pulse on Stratus account — weekly health check. Usage up ~18% w/w, invoice run shows spend +12% (mostly /chat). Streaming p95 improved to ~120ms but p99 for /chat still spikes ~1.4s. Non-stream /generate p95 ~240ms p99 ~1.1s. Error rate steady at 0.6% but errors cluster with the p99 tail.

mike-sre: Got it — looking at traces now. p99 seems correlated with long-sequence sessions + occasional cold KV cache. Grafana view: https://grafana.redwood/stratus/traces (watch the tail).

jess-pm: Which model variants are routing for /chat vs /generate? Any quantized fallbacks?

tariq-eng: /chat currently routes to redwood/gpt-chat-4o-mini-quant (hosted). Fallback policy sends to open-7b when capacity is constrained. KV cache miss rate ~67% for chat sessions (session IDs not being preserved by their frontend).

anya-cs: Renewal note: customer flagged cost sensitivity — they asked if latency fixes could lower unit cost. Recommend: enable prefix/KV caching for active sessions, try tighter batching window (10ms) and run a dedicated-pool canary using a slightly cheaper model variant for low-priority routes.

mike-sre: I can run a 2h canary on dedicated-pool-2. Quick query I used to baseline tails:

```sql
select route, model, percentile(lat_ms, 95) as p95, percentile(lat_ms,99) as p99, count(*)
from inference.traces
where account = 'stratus' and ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
group by 1,2
order by p99 desc;
```

I'll snapshot results before/after.

tariq-eng: Technical notes: 1) If we enable prefix caching we need their frontend to stop rotating session tokens every request. 2) For streaming, enabling chunked responses for long outputs will reduce perceived p99 for users. 3) Consider increasing dedicated burst capacity during their peak window (18:00-20:00 UTC).

jess-pm: Action items and owners: 1) SRE run canary + post baseline (mike) 2) Eng enable/validate KV caching + confirm frontend change (tariq) 3) CS draft cost/benefit note for Stratus with expected savings (anya) 4) Schedule 1:1 with Stratus AM to align on risk & plan (jess).

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started to dedicated-pool-2 at 1724500180 — canary id canary-573.

anya-cs: :thumbsup: Thanks — please tag me on the canary results. I'll prep the cost note and a short customer-facing FAQ for the frontend change.

mike-sre: Will post canary baseline + 2h snapshot here by EOD. Initial quick table (24h baseline):

```
route      | model                      | p95  | p99  | notes
/chat      | gpt-chat-4o-mini-quant     | 120ms| 1400ms | KV miss heavy
/generate  | open-7b                    | 240ms| 1100ms | batch spikes
/embeddings| embed-lite                 | 80ms | 220ms  | stable
```

mike-sre: Adding follow-ups to SRE backlog: increase KV warming, run canary, monitor cost delta.

anya-cs: Great, keeping this thread as the single source for the Stratus health check. If anyone hits a blocker ping me or @jess-pm.

cs-bot: Note: Stratus billing alert triggered 1 day ago (spend > forecast).
